translations.future_implementation_requirement: Implement computed aggregate, split-level, confidence or repeated-seed, and tie-blocking checks.
must_block_if: aggregate success attempts to rescue critical split failure
95 percent lower bound is not greater than 0.05 and no justified repeated-seed replacement exists

translations.future_implementation_requirement: Candidate and baselines use the same legal observation, action, feedback, history, query, update, and state-capacity interface unless a recorded parity exception blocks or justifies comparison.
must_block_if: legal feedback available to candidate is denied to baseline
hidden label is used in a decision-time metric

translations.future_implementation_requirement: Trace uncertainty, policy-chosen query, changed observation or feedback, serialized-state update, and later-action change against no-query and shuffled-feedback counterfactuals.
must_block_if: query is injected by harness default
feedback does not update serialized state
later action is unchanged under counterfactuals
no-active-query or shuffled-feedback drop is below 0.20

translations.future_implementation_requirement: Invoke every mandatory baseline as an independent callable on every required split and select strongest baseline by computed metric.
must_block_if: baseline is declared but not invoked
baseline output is literal or static JSON
baseline shares candidate policy or update code
disabling a mandatory baseline does not fail the harness

translations.future_implementation_requirement: Scan real bundle and contaminated positive-control bundle through the same callable scanner path.
must_block_if: real-bundle scan is replaced by synthetic-only scan
excluded paths are marked clean instead of not_scanned

translations.future_implementation_requirement: Replay recomputes action and state update from serialized state, observation, policy path, update path, and feedback history.
must_block_if: corrupted-state or corrupted-feedback failure paths do not fail

translations.future_implementation_requirement: Every score, baseline, ablation, leakage, replay, and verdict metric records callable producer provenance.
